interface.shortDescription: kape-controller sandbox-agent dispatch skill for Claude Code and Codex.
interface.longDescription: kape is the kape platform plugin, packaged self-contained under plugins/kape/. The skills/ tree ships to both Claude Code and Codex. The dispatch skill teaches agents to consume the kape-controller MCP interface properly: discover the tool surface from the server itself, run the dispatch lifecycle, classify errors, and consume sandbox-agent output efficiently.
